description: Cleansed and deduplicated sales orders from the raw Bronze layer. Serves as the validated source for Gold star schemas.

schema.name: order_id
schema.description: Unique order identifier, carried from source with no transformation.

schema.name: customer_id
schema.description: Customer identifier, validated against the customer dimension.

schema.name: quantity
schema.description: Order line quantity; must be positive.

schema.name: unit_price_gbp
schema.description: Unit price in GBP normalised from source currency.

schema.name: discount_pct
schema.description: Discount percentage applied to the line (0–1 range). Null means no discount.

schema.name: quarantine_reason
schema.description: Populated when a record is flagged by quality rules but retained for audit. Null for conforming records.

schema.name: ingested_at
schema.description: UTC timestamp when the record was written to Silver.

schema.name: source_file
schema.description: Source file path from Auto Loader, for lineage.

qualityChecks.name: discount_range
qualityChecks.rule: discount_pct IS NULL OR (discount_pct >= 0 AND discount_pct <= 1)
